Hi,

I'm running a tourney right now and two doubts:

1. Can Tye Cooper burn a uncontrolled minion? The text says 'non-
ready', but there's nothing specific about beeing controlled or not.

Tye Cooper [LotN:R]
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Giovanni
Cost: 3 pool
Unique wraith with 1 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Tye is immune to non-aggravated damage. He may burn a non-ready minion
as a (D) action. If that action is successful, you may move a library
card from your ash heap to your hand (discard afterward).

2. If Gratiano loses it's Priscus title, becoming Cardinal, for
example, can he still cast his additional vote in the Prisci sub-
referendum?

Tks.

Marlo

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <59b6d60f-6b85-413b...@m45g2000hsb.googlegroup

s.com>, Marlo - The Iceman <marlo...@gmail.com> writes:
>1. Can Tye Cooper burn a uncontrolled minion? The text says 'non-
>ready', but there's nothing specific about beeing controlled or not.

By default, uncontrolled cards aren't legal targets. You need explicit
card text to over-turn that.

So Tye can't target them, but could target a hospitalized Imbued or a
torporized vampire.

>2. If Gratiano loses it's Priscus title, becoming Cardinal, for
>example, can he still cast his additional vote in the Prisci sub-
>referendum?

Yes.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/a9e0e7bfb00acdd8
